chapterInfo.content:
3
Adeɛ biara wɔ ne berɛ, na Onyankopɔn deɛ, ɔtim hɔ daa
1 # Ɔsɛ 8.6 Adeɛ biara wɔ ne berɛ a wɔahyɛ no, na ɛberɛ wɔ hɔ ma adwuma biara ɔsoro ase:
2Awoɔ wɔ ne berɛ, na owuo wɔ ne berɛ;
ɔtɛ wɔ ne berɛ, na deɛ wɔatɛ no tutuo wɔ ne berɛ;
3okum wɔ ne berɛ, na ayaresa wɔ ne berɛ;
bubuo wɔ ne berɛ, na osie wɔ ne berɛ;
4esu wɔ ne berɛ, na sereɛ wɔ ne berɛ;
abooboodie wɔ ne berɛ, na asa wɔ ne berɛ;
5aboɔ toguo wɔ ne berɛ, na aboɔ anoboa wɔ ne berɛ;
atuuyɛ wɔ ne berɛ, na atuuyɛ ntetemu wɔ ne berɛ;
6ɔhwehwɛ wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔyera wɔ ne berɛ;
nhwɛsoɔ wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔtoguo wɔ ne berɛ;
7osuane wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔpam wɔ ne berɛ;
kommyɛ wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔkasa wɔ ne berɛ;
8ɔdɔ wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔtane wɔ ne berɛ;
akodie wɔ ne berɛ, na ɔmannwoeɛ wɔ ne berɛ.
9Mfasoɔ bɛn na deɛ ɔyɛ adwuma no nya no deɛ ɔbrɛ ho no mu?
10Mahunu ɔbrɛ adwuma a Onyankopɔn de ama adasamma sɛ wɔmmrɛ nyɛ no. 11#Ɔsɛ 8.17 Wayɛ adeɛ nyinaa fɛfɛ ne berɛ mu; bio nso, ɔde mmerɛ santen ho adwene ahyɛ wɔn akoma mu, nanso nnipa ntumi nhunu deɛ Onyankopɔn ayɛ firi mfitiaseɛ kɔsi awieeɛ no. 12#Ɔsɛ 2.24 Menim sɛ biribiara nni hɔ a ɛyɛ ma wɔn kyɛn sɛ wɔbɛgye wɔn ani, asɛpɛ wɔn ho wɔ wɔn nkwa nna mu; 13nanso sɛ onipa biara didi nom hunu adepa ne brɛ nyinaa mu a, Nyankopɔn akyɛdeɛ ne no. 14Menim sɛ adeɛ biara a Onyankopɔn yɛ no, ɛno na ɛbɛtena hɔ daa; wɔrentumi mfa bi nka ho, na wɔrentumi nyi bi mfiri mu. Na Onyankopɔn ayɛ no saa sɛdeɛ nnipa bɛsuro n’anim. 15Deɛ ɛba no yɛ teteete adeɛ, na deɛ ɛrebɛba no nso, ɛbaa teteete, na Onyankopɔn hwehwɛ deɛ ɛsene kɔ bio.
Suro Onyankopɔn, na tɔ wo bo ase
16Na deɛ mahunu bio owia yi aseɛ ne atemmubea a abɔnefosɛm wɔ hɔ ne teneneebea a amumuyɛ wɔ hɔ. 17#Ɔsɛ 12.14 Mekaa no m’akomam sɛ: Ɔteneneeni ne ɔbɔnefoɔ nyinaa, Onyankopɔn bɛbu wɔn atɛn, ɛfiri sɛ wahyɛ berɛ ama adwuma biara ne adeyɛ biara. 18Mekaa no m’akomam wɔ nnipa mma ho sɛ, Onyankopɔn resɔ wɔn ahwɛ, na wɔahunu sɛ wɔn fam no, wɔte sɛ mmoa ara nko. 19#Dwom 49.12, 20 Na nnipa mma hyɛberɛ ne mmoa hyɛberɛ sɛ, na hyɛberɛ korɔ da hɔ ma wɔn, sɛ oyi wuo teɛ no, sɛ oyi wuo nso teɛ ne no, na honhom baako na wɔn nyinaa wɔ, na kyɛne a onipa bɛkyɛne aboa nni hɔ; na adeɛ nyinaa yɛ ahuhudeɛ. 20#Gye 3.19 Adeɛ nyinaa kɔ faako, adeɛ biara firi dɔteɛ mu, na adeɛ nyinaa sane kɔ dɔteɛ mu. 21#Ɔsɛ 12.7 Hwan na ɔnim nnipa mma honhom sɛ ɔforo kɔ ɔsoro ne mmoa honhom sɛ ɔsiane kɔ asase aseɛ? 22Na mehunuu sɛ adepa biara nni hɔ gye sɛ onipa ani gye ne nnwuma mu, na ɛne ne kyɛfa. Na hwan na ɔde no bɛba na wabɛhwɛ deɛ ɛbɛba akyire no?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
